question: Which of the following personality is associated with Aligarh movement?
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Syed Ahmed Khan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Syed Ahmed Khan** is associated with the Aligarh movement, which was a **socio-religious reform movement in the 19th century** aimed at uplifting the Muslim community in India.
 
• **Syed Ahmed Khan was a prominent Muslim reformer and educationist** who believed that education was the key to the progress and empowerment of the Muslim community.
 
• He founded the** Muhammadan Anglo-Oriental College in Aligarh,** which later became Aligarh Muslim University, to provide modern education to Muslims and to promote communal harmony.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Muhammad Ali Jinnah, Abul Kalam Azad, and Syed Amir Ali **were also prominent Muslim leaders and reformers, but they were associated with different movements and ideologies.
 
• ** Muhammad Ali Jinnah was a leader of the All-India Muslim League** and played a key role in the partition of India and the creation of Pakistan.
 
• ** Abul Kalam Azad was a nationalist Muslim** leader who opposed the idea of partition and worked for Hindu-Muslim unity.
 
• ** Syed Amir Ali was a lawyer and politician** who was associated with the Indian National Congress and worked for the rights of Muslims in India.**.**
